backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing user profile management, transcription history storage, and role-based access control with admin/user permissions using Internet Identity principals.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three audio playback debugging tasks for the Mood Music feature, linking implementation files to test requirements REQ-15, REQ-16, and REQ-17.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON-formatted summaries of all frontend source files including the Mood Music feature components, audio player hook with error handling, catalog with SoundHelix demo URLs, and authentication/UI components.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with OKLCH color system defining light and dark mode color tokens using grayscale and teal/cyan accents (avoiding blue/purple).
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React application with viewport meta tags and module script loading for the speech-to-text/text-to-speech web app.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application component with tabbed interface for Mood Music, audio recording, transcription, text-to-speech, and history features, including Internet Identity authentication and profile setup flow.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Authentication button component managing Internet Identity login/logout with loading states, error handling, and query cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/auth/ProfileSetu: Modal dialog for first-time user profile setup with pre-populated name field ('Alhat Rutuja') and Mood Based Music branding, preventing dismissal until profile is saved.
frontend/src/components/InfoNotice.tsx: Informational alert component explaining that the app uses browser-native speech APIs without external services, with browser compatibility guidance.
frontend/src/features/audio/AudioRecorde: React component for recording audio from the microphone with play/pause controls, timer display, and playback functionality. Handles MediaRecorder API, permission errors, and audio blob creation.
frontend/src/features/history/HistoryPan: React component displaying transcript history with save functionality, requiring authentication. Shows saved transcripts in reverse chronological order with loading states and empty state handling.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/catalog: Static music catalog data containing sample tracks with metadata (title, artist, moods, date, URL). Uses placeholder SoundHelix MP3 URLs for demonstration.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/compone: Simple alert component displaying informational notice about sample audio tracks and browser-based playback.
Grid of clickable mood cards (Happy, Calm, Sad, Energetic) with icons and visual selection state. Handles mood selection callback.
Displays filtered tracks as cards with play/pause buttons, track metadata, and mood badges. Shows currently playing track with visual highlighting and error states.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/MoodMus: Main mood music feature component that combines mood selection, track filtering/sorting, and a sticky audio player with progress controls. Manages state for mood selection and sort mode.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/types.t: TypeScript type definitions for mood music feature: Mood union type, SortMode, and Track interface with metadata fields.
frontend/src/features/mood-music/useAudi: Custom React hook managing HTML5 Audio element lifecycle, playback state, time tracking, and error handling. Provides play, pause, seek, and toggle functions with comprehensive event listeners.
frontend/src/features/stt/TranscriptionP: React component that provides a UI panel for speech-to-text transcription with start/stop/clear controls, displays live and final transcripts in an editable textarea, and shows browser compatibility alerts.
frontend/src/features/stt/useSpeechRecog: Custom React hook that wraps the browser's Web Speech API for speech recognition, managing continuous listening state, interim and final transcripts, error handling, and browser compatibility detection.
frontend/src/features/tts/TextToSpeechPa: React component that provides a UI panel for text-to-speech functionality with voice selection, speaking rate control, and play/stop buttons to read transcribed text aloud.
frontend/src/features/tts/useSpeechSynth: Custom React hook that wraps the browser's Speech Synthesis API, managing available voices, speaking state, speech rate, and providing speak/stop functions for text-to-speech conversion.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom React hook that manages the Internet Computer backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on identity state and initializing access control with an admin token from URL parameters.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle with configurable options for idle handling and identity provider.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for backend data operations including fetching/saving user profiles, saving transcription entries, and retrieving transcription history with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration file defining CSS custom properties for light and dark themes, including color variables for UI components (primary, secondary, accent, destructive, sidebar, charts) using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React root with QueryClient for data fetching and InternetIdentityProvider for authentication, then renders the main App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage integration for parameter persistence across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color system, typography, container queries, animations (accordion), custom fonts (Inter, JetBrains Mono), and plugins for typography and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing a Mood Based Music app with React frontend and Node.js backend, tracking architectural decisions, known issues (audio playback not visible), existing features (audio recording, STT/TTS, Internet Identity auth), and implementation constraints.
